metadata.title: Hierarchical clustering of the pre-exam anxiety levels in physically inactive and active adolescent students from 56 countries: an observational study using PISA program data
metadata.venue: Frontiers in Sports and Active Living

design_fields.q1_rationale: The study does not use ILSA achievement data as an outcome or predictor, focusing instead on country-level anxiety percentages.
design_fields.q2_rationale: The study does not report applying PISA sampling weights or replicate-weight procedures in the analysis.
design_fields.q3_rationale: The study does not use multilevel modeling or account for school clustering, as it analyzes country-level data rather than individual student data.
design_fields.q4_rationale: The study mentions internal validation methods such as silhouette scores and within-cluster sum of squares, indicating only internal validation was performed.
